definitions.short: Beth-ha-Ram , a place East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H1027. Beth Haram הָרָם בֵּית proper name, of a location in Gad Josh 13:27 = הָרָן בֵּית Num 32:36 , modern Beit Harrân , 1 hour east of Jordan, opposite Jericho, Tristr Moab 348 ; name Tell er-Ram(eh) Merrill PE Soc. iv. 1877 Schick ZPV 1879, 3, 246 (compare Lag Onom. 103. 16, 2nd ed. 137 and others) הָרָן בֵּית see הָרָם בֵּית
definitions.rootNote: from 1004 and 7311 with the article interposed; house of the height;

occurrences.englishText: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.
